output.headline: The insurer has made deductions from your hospital bill, but some parts can be challenged.
what_happened: Suraksha Health Insurance Co. has reviewed your claim for the right hip hemiarthroplasty.
They paid a part of the bill, but deducted some amounts for room rent, co-payment, and other items.
why: Non-payable items like laundry are not covered by the policy.
Proportionate deductions were applied because you used a room above your policy limit.
Some deductions were wrongly applied to items that should not be reduced under the rules.
next_steps: Ask the hospital desk to help prepare an appeal for the disputed deductions.
Keep all your policy papers and final bills safely with you.
Submit the missing investigation reports and implant invoice to support your claim.
Check with the hospital billing desk before paying any difference.
output.reassurance: We are helping you sort through these deductions so you can understand every step clearly.
